caption_semantics.metric: Equal axes in the declared scaled Euclidean metric: steering displacement divided by the first scale, log10-temperature displacement divided by the second scale.
caption_semantics.frame: Left: conditional trace-Hessian predictor rays and full planned transverse section supports, not measured valley connections.
caption_semantics.measurements: Right: every observed sample on the four innermost planned sections; independently qualified minima are not joined.
caption_semantics.markers: Dots are admitted samples; stars and black bars show qualified minima and measured final bracket widths. Red crosses and pluses retain unadmitted samples and unfinished callbacks.
caption_semantics.brackets: Black bars are not confidence intervals or exact extremum enclosures.
caption_semantics.status: All four section statuses and sample/minimum counts are retained. No bracket means no strict minimum bracket on the sampled mesh; missing sections remain untested.
caption_semantics.limits: Finite section minima do not establish connected intrinsic valleys or an exact crossing. Conditional frame geometry is separate from measured section evidence.
